name: 課題一覧の情報行
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct the supplied LH09-0001 task-row image. Image 1 is the edit target, image 2 is the exact Japanese layout and typography reference.
Make a tightly framed panoramic component export with the row filling the image and only a few pixels of white padding. Remove the excessive blank canvas above and below. Match the thin compact source row geometry (960 by 44 logical pixels). Keep Japanese typography visibly regular, body 14/24 and metadata 12/16 in Meiryo, zero tracking. Match source relative positions and sizes. No extra cards, labels, text, controls, content or ornament.
Preserve exact text: 作業-11 / 利用者の声を整理する / 調査 / 礼拝改善 / 4月1日.
Preserve priority bars, half-progress status, both white outlined green-dot chips, slate outlined assignee and date. Preserve pure white background, restrained neutral outline and very soft shadow. Forest green only for progress and category dots, slate #526173 utility icons. No green wash, no large type, no bold title, no primary action invented. Only correct framing and typography; retain content and one-row structure.
reviewNotes: 修正試行v002を実見。日本語の内容は保持。広い上下余白が残存。新しい所有者指示に従い原画像のアイコン細部を優先して再修正が必要。進捗円と担当者の点線外周、原画像にあるプロジェクトバッジの省略が課題。v001を保持。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
